title: Electric Toothbrushes: Oral-B, Revyline and Accessories
metaDescription: Comparing three electric toothbrushes: the premium Oral-B iO 6 (iO technology), the sonic Revyline RL 075 Duo two-pack, and the kids' Oral-B Vitality Pro Kids — how to pick the right one for your needs.
author: ByteBuy Team

sections.content: 'Electric toothbrush' isn't one type of device — it covers at least two different cleaning principles: rotating-oscillating technology (like Oral-B's iO) and sonic technology with a cavitation effect (like Revyline). On top of that, kids' brushes are their own category, where the cleaning technology matters less than whether the brush actually gets the child brushing in the first place. We're covering three specific catalog models here — one for each of these needs.

items.label: Oral-B iO 6 Grey Opal
items.value: iO technology (rotation + pulsation), app connectivity, quieter and gentler than other Oral-B lines — a premium single brush

items.label: Revyline RL 075 Duo
items.value: Sonic technology with a cavitation effect (micro-bubbles from paste/saliva/water), a 2-brush set — for a couple or a family

items.label: Oral-B Vitality Pro Kids D103
items.value: Ultra-soft bristles, app with Disney characters, a gamified 2-minute timer — a kids' brush

items.label: What they have in common
items.value: All three are electric brushes rather than manual — the cleaning technology differs for each, and the right pick depends on the job, not on which one is 'best'

pros: The Oral-B iO 6 combines rotation and pulsation in one technology — the manufacturer claims quieter, gentler operation compared to other Oral-B lines
The Revyline RL 075 ships as a 2-brush set — no need to buy a second brush separately for a second person in the house
Revyline's sonic technology creates a cavitation effect through liquid micro-bubbles rather than mechanical contact alone — gentler on enamel and gums
The kids' Oral-B Vitality Pro Kids uses a gamified timer and a Disney-character app, which genuinely helps get a child brushing for the full 2 minutes instead of 20 seconds
All three use ultra-soft or softened bristles compared to the standard — lower risk of irritating gums with normal use
cons: The Oral-B iO 6 is the most expensive of the three (14,590 RUB) — not a budget entry point into electric brushing
The Revyline set is designed for two people — if you only need one brush, paying for the second one in the bundle isn't always worth it
The kids' Oral-B brush needs a smartphone for the app's timer to work — without it, you're left with a plain electric brush and no game mechanic
App connectivity (on both the iO and the kids' model) is an extra setup step that not everyone needs or wants

products.title: Oral-B Electric Toothbrush
products.description: The Oral-B iO 6 Grey Opal electric toothbrush cares for your mouth far more effectively than a manual brush. The innovative iO technology delivers a professional-clean feel every day, and lets the brush run quieter and gentler than other Oral-B lines. Connects to the mobile app.

products.title: Revyline Toothbrush Set
products.description: Revyline RL 075 — electric toothbrushes with a unique sonic cleaning technology that creates a cavitation effect: as toothpaste, saliva and water interact, micro-bubbles form. When they collapse, they produce powerful micro-impacts that effectively remove plaque from the enamel surface.

products.title: Oral-B Toothbrush
products.description: The Oral-B Vitality Pro Kids D103 Chameleon is an electric toothbrush with ultra-soft bristles for children, combining real technology with a fun design. An interactive app with Disney characters helps build the habit of brushing for 2 minutes, making the process engaging through a gamified timer.

items.question: How is Oral-B's rotating technology fundamentally different from Revyline's sonic technology?
items.answer: Oral-B's iO combines mechanical rotation and pulsation of the brush head — cleaning happens through direct contact between the bristles and the tooth. Revyline uses sonic technology: high-frequency vibrations create a cavitation effect — collapsing micro-bubbles in the mix of toothpaste, saliva and water that help remove plaque even where the bristles don't make direct contact. It's not a question of which is 'better' — they're different mechanisms.

items.question: Is it worth paying extra for the Oral-B iO 6 if simpler electric brushes exist?
items.answer: The iO 6 is in the premium segment: the price reflects the iO technology, the claimed quieter and gentler operation, and the app ecosystem. If a budget entry point into electric brushing is the priority, it makes more sense to start with a simpler model and move up later if needed, rather than starting with the top-tier line.

items.question: Is the Revyline set two identical brushes?
items.answer: Yes, the RL 075 Duo kit includes two electric brushes (pink and beige in this colorway) — designed for two users in one household, not as a spare brush.

items.question: What age is appropriate for a kid's electric brush like the Oral-B Vitality Pro Kids?
items.answer: The manufacturer designed this model with ultra-soft bristles specifically for a child's sensitive gums, and the app's gamified timer with Disney characters is meant to get the child to want to brush for the full 2 minutes on their own. The exact recommended age is worth checking in the specific model's description from the manufacturer or with a dentist — it also depends on how capable the child already is of using the brush independently.

sections.content: This isn't about which brush is 'best' — it's three different scenarios. The Oral-B iO 6 is a premium single brush with rotating-pulsating technology for those ready to pay for the top tier. The Revyline RL 075 Duo is a sonic set for two at a reasonable price for electric brushes. The Oral-B Vitality Pro Kids is a kids' model where the key value isn't the cleaning technology but the fact that the child will actually use it, thanks to the gamified timer. Base your choice on who's using the brush and for what, not on an overall model ranking.
